definition: A GPU attention kernel that exploits Hopper architecture features such as asynchronous TMA and WGMMA to accelerate attention computation with FP8 support.
details: FlashAttention-3 improves on prior FlashAttention versions by overlapping softmax and matrix-multiply operations and using warp-specialized producer-consumer pipelines. It achieves significant speedups on H100 GPUs for both FP16 and FP8 attention. The work is from the same team that pioneered FlashAttention and targets the NVIDIA Hopper generation.

citation.title: FlashAttention-3: Fast and Accurate Attention with Asynchrony and Low-precision
